app.name: SIP doorbell
app.summary: A native SIP phone on the panel: register to the PBX, answer the door, call out and open the door.
app.option_target_hint: The number the Call door key dials.
app.option_station_hint: The number the Call station key dials.
app.setting_auto_answer_hint: Answer an incoming door call as soon as it rings.
app.setting_ring_popup_hint: Show Answer and Decline over the screen while the doorbell rings.
app.input_sip_server_hint: PBX address on the LAN, for example 192.168.1.10.
app.input_sip_port_hint: The PBX SIP port; 5062 is the DoorPi example, 5060 is common.
app.input_sip_user_hint: The extension number or SIP username.
app.input_sip_password_hint: The extension password. Tessera stores it in the plugin record; use a dedicated LAN extension.
app.input_sip_domain_hint: The SIP domain/realm; usually the PBX address on a LAN.
app.input_sip_caller_hint: The display name sent on outgoing calls, for example Gang.
app.input_sip_transport_hint: udp, ws or wss. UDP is for a PBX on the same LAN; ws/wss needs ESP-IDF and a WebSocket transport on the PBX.
